Only EPS and cumulative PAT were recoverable: from The Business Standard's news coverage of the disclosure, cross-checked against DSE's own company page (dsebd.org displayCompany.php?name=BRACBANK), whose 'Interim Financial Performance: 2026' table independently confirms Basic EPS of exactly 2.900 for the Q1 (period ending 202603) column — an exact match, giving confidence in the figure despite the primary PDF being unavailable. No balance sheet, P&L breakdown, deposits, loans, or asset-quality figures could be recovered for this quarter — left as explicit gaps rather than estimated or backfilled from annual data. Consolidated net profit BDT 6,957m (Tk 695.68 crore) for Jan-Mar 2026, +44% YoY, attributed by the bank to higher investment and interest income.
